research_scope: Counter Burst — Ki Blast Super / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No prior repository research commit for Counter Burst was found.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Counter Burst as a Ki Blast Super and Counter Skill.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Counter Burst is obtained from Parallel Quest 75 — Room to Spare.
verification_audit.finish_finding: The maintained all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Counter Burst under PQ75 Basic Reward, so an Ultimate Finish is not required.
verification_audit.cost_finding: The skill reference lists 100 Ki. No reliable reviewed source established a stamina cost or drop probability, so those remain null.
verification_audit.availability_finding: Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies the Future Warrior as an obtainable user; Vegeta partner customization is also documented after the relevant update.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The documented counter places a barrier in front of the user, triggers against a Ki Blast skill, and returns a six-hit Ki projectile that knocks the opponent away. The approximately 20% damage report is retained only as contextual evidence.
verification_audit.method: Revalidated the existing Counter Burst evidence boundary and acquisition semantics against current Xenoverse 2-specific skill and PQ references; no unsupported combat values were promoted.

records.name: Counter Burst
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Counter Burst under PQ75 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Raise a barrier to stop an incoming Ki Blast and counter with a stronger Ki Blast.
records.mechanics_notes: The documented behavior is a frontal barrier that activates when struck by a Ki Blast skill, followed by a six-hit Ki projectile that knocks the opponent away. The reviewed reference reports approximately 20% damage; this remains contextual and is not promoted as universal numeric canonical data.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ75 is the documented Future Warrior acquisition route. Counter Burst is listed as a Basic Reward, so no Ultimate Finish is required. No unsupported drop probability is recorded.
records.pve_notes: The skill is a documented PQ75 Basic Reward and is specifically designed to answer Ki Blast attacks.
records.pvp_notes: Its counter trigger is documented for Ki Blast attacks. Exact matchup, timing, frame, and hitbox behavior remain version-sensitive and are not expanded beyond the cited evidence.
